title: The Misfit's Guide to Reclaiming Your Power
author: Mark J. Hubrich & Eli
subtitle: From Burnout to Brilliance
description: You were never broken. You were always the prototype. A field guide for the misfits, the too-much, the wired-different — reclaiming your energy, agency, and power in a world built for conformity.
